what: Costco.com product-page fields read on 2026-09-23 (US Eastern; 2026-09-24 UTC) in an in-app browser session by running COSTCO_CAPTURE_JS (scripts/fetch_prices.py) on each product page and transcribing the returned JSON unchanged. The warehouse price is rendered client-side for the selected warehouse, so it cannot be read from a scripted HTTP fetch; this record is the source.

location_context.note: costco.com chose the warehouse and delivery ZIP from the visitor IP; nothing was set by hand.

price_fields.ld_price: schema.org Product offer price in the page JSON-LD (equals the online price)
